summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the introduction of YeeZo, an AI workflow and orchestration platform for cost-efficient AI content production. The filing contains no transaction, no special situation event—it is a routine product launch disclosure. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no structural mechanics, and no regulatory clock. This is an ordinary current report of a foreign private issuer. No special-situation category applies.
